scope: CPU Three actual company asset chain plus ownership module

implementation.behavior: Module-level decoded-image ownership counts are incremented for every pack, instance, and surface-finish texture. Texture dispose listeners decrement once and close only the final close-capable image. Release registers all discovered textures before disposal.

orphanImageAnalysis.result: No successful standalone ImageBitmap owner was found in the locked path. ImageBitmapLoader wraps each successful decode in a Texture before resolving, and images without a referenced texture are never requested. Parser cache cleanup still awaits texture dependencies.
